rules.tone: A working creator talking to another one: plain, a bit tired, specific about what they changed. Never agency voice.

sub: here is what the saved ones do

ranked.name: Lead with a number
lines: A count tells the reader how long this will take. Four things gets swiped; some thoughts on does not.
Put it in the first three words, not the second line.

ranked.name: Rank it worst to best
lines: A countdown gives the swipe a destination. Every slide promises the next one is better.
Ranking forces you to have an opinion, which is the actual scarce thing.

ranked.name: One idea per slide
lines: Two ideas on a slide means neither is remembered. Split it and take the extra slide.
If a slide needs a paragraph to explain, it is two slides.

notes: #ad belongs in the first line of the caption, never after the hashtags
Write Signal Studio in full the first time it appears on a slide
No screenshots of other people's analytics

guidance.hook_style: Name the failure first, in the creator's own words, then the count. Never a question.
